# AI Peak Biz

> AI Peak Biz is a revenue recovery and customer communication company for service businesses. We build and manage AI-powered front desk systems that answer calls, respond to leads, book appointments, and reactivate dormant customers. Founded by Wylie Stevens in Kingman, Arizona.

## Services
- AI Voice Assistant: 24/7 AI-powered call answering trained on your business
- Missed Call Text-Back: Instant SMS response when calls are missed
- AI Chatbot: Website visitor engagement and appointment booking
- Database Reactivation: Re-engage past customers with AI-powered outreach
- AI Appointment Setter: Outbound AI that books appointments from leads
- Reputation Management: Automated review requests after service
- Website Design: Conversion-optimized sites for service businesses
- AI Consulting & Teaching: Training for businesses wanting to implement AI themselves

## Industries Served
Home Services, HVAC, Roofing, Plumbing, Electrical, Construction, Healthcare, Chiropractic, Dental, Legal, Real Estate, Automotive, Beauty, Hospitality, Financial, Education, Fitness & Wellness, Trades & Specialty

## Pricing
- AI Front Desk (Essentials): $4,997 deployment + $997/month
- Revenue Recovery (Growth): $7,997 deployment + $1,497/month
- AI Revenue Deployment (Peak): $14,997 deployment + $2,497/month
